[ERROR LIST]
- Line 3: File opened without `with`/`close()`; the handle is only closed by implicit finalization. No handling for `FileNotFoundError` (missing `uploads/char.txt`) or `UnicodeDecodeError` (non-UTF-8 bytes); either aborts the script uncaught.
- Line 6: `[IVXLCDMivxlcdm]+` does not validate Roman-numeral structure, so any bracketed word composed only of those letters is deleted by `sgl_marker`/`dbl_marker` (e.g. `[Mild]`, `[civil]`, `[DVD]`, `[mix]`, `[Vic]`). `[A-Za-z]` deletes single-letter editorial insertions (`author[s]` → `author`). `note`, `citation needed`, `edit` are case-sensitive, so `[Note 1]`, `[Citation needed]`, `[Edit]` are left in place.
- Line 7: `link_re` deletes the entire link including its visible text, removing prose words (`born in [Paris](url).` → `born in .`). The image prefix `!` is not consumed, so `![alt](src)` leaves a stray `!`. The URL class `[^()\s]*` fails on URLs containing parentheses (e.g. `…/Foo_(bar)`) and on links with titles (`[t](url "Title")`); such links survive the loop, then line 25 strips only the URL, leaving `` / `[t]( "Title")` in the output.
- Line 8: `url_re` has no end-boundary logic; trailing sentence punctuation/delimiters (`.`, `,`, `;`, `)`, `]`) immediately following a bare URL are consumed and deleted (`see ` → `see `; `(` → `(`).
- Line 11: `[#*-]` (applied at line 28) deletes every ASCII hyphen-minus, merging hyphenated words (`well-known` → `wellknown`), numeric/date ranges (`1990-1995` → `19901995`), negative numbers (`-5` → `5`), and `#` in identifiers (`C#` → `C`). Heading/list markers are removed without the following space (`# Title` → ` Title`, `- item` → ` item`).
- Line 12: `<[^>]*>` matches any `<…>` span, not only HTML tags; a prose line containing both `<` and `>` (e.g. `a < b and c > d`) loses everything between them (`a  d`). Tags/comments spanning multiple lines are never matched because processing is per line; e.g. a multi-line `<!-- … -->` leaves `<!` (after line 28 removes the hyphens) and `>` fragments.
- Line 13: `caret_ref` also matches footnote definition lines `[^1_14]: `; after line 25 removes the URL an orphan `: ` line remains. Likewise reference definitions `[1]: url` become `: ` (lines 25/27), and reference-style links `[text][1]` leave `[text]`.
- Line 16: Backticks are stripped before lines 17–28 run, so inline code spans receive no protection: `` `<div>` `` is deleted as an HTML tag by line 17; `` `x-1` `` → `x1`; `` `[1]` `` is deleted by line 27. Inconsistent with the fenced-code protection in lines 34–38.
- Line 28: Ordering flaw with line 27. Range citations `[1-3]` are not matched by `sgl_marker` (hyphen not in `marker`); line 28 then removes the hyphen, producing `[13]`. Comma lists `[1,2]` / `[1, 2]` are never removed.
- Line 34: Fence detection only recognises ``` at column 0. Indented fences (CommonMark allows up to 3 leading spaces; standard inside list items) and `~~~` fences are not detected, so `in_code` inverts for the remainder of the file: following prose is emitted unsanitized and/or code is sanitized. An unbalanced fence is only reported via line 41's print; no correction or error is raised.
